title: Hard-Rule Gate Rerun / Fix after P8.1 pass_with_warning

rerun_decision.reason: P8.1 resolved missing inputs and passed schema/reference/boundary checks, but 11 deeper instantiated integrity checks remain not_run and the imported P8 self-check still reports hard_rule_pass false.

integrity_warning_classification.required_local_action: Verify that FullSeriesArcSpec and SeasonPlan references align on series_id, season_id, target_episode_count, season goal, central conflict axis, and ending state.
Verify that EpisodeArcChain covers the target episode count and preserves season-level entry/exit state, escalation, midpoint, crisis, climax, and resolution expectations.
Verify that each episode node has sequence references or sequence counts consistent with the package inventory and v5 SequenceBlueprint evidence.
Verify that sequence scene spans and scene bundle references are internally coherent and do not leave required sequence transitions unsupported.
Verify that every scene blueprint reference has a corresponding renderer prompt packet reference and that renderer packets do not unlock long-range structure.
Verify that plant/payoff ledgers have no orphan plants, payoff-without-plant cases, impossible timing, or unresolved critical setup.
Verify that character state changes have causal support and do not create unsupported belief, agency, or motivation jumps.
Verify that relationship state changes are supported by scene/sequence events and do not reverse without designed cause.
Verify that episode and sequence transitions preserve causal dependency and do not contain missing causes, impossible effects, or unsupported reversals.
Verify that episode and sequence hooks point to actual downstream consequences and do not function as isolated cliffhangers.
Verify that scene function distribution and sequence rhythm do not collapse into monotony and remain compatible with the declared genre mode.

codex_local_reason: The 11 deeper integrity checks require local inspection of package references, SeqCard v5 inventories, EpisodeArc inventory, SequenceBlueprint inventory, and fixture bundles. ChatGPT can define the contract and decision policy, but should not fabricate execution evidence.
next_required_step: Codex-local execution of P8.2 deeper integrity checks, then hard-rule self-check v2 or rerun result.
